{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Trump deepened US support for the Saudi-Emirati intervention in Yemen.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump increased arms sales to the Saudi kingdom.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump emphatically embraced the reactionary agendas and repressive policies of the Gulf monarchies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Trump administration announced that the US military would no longer refuel Saudi coalition planes amid the global outcry over the Saudi kingdom’s gruesome murder of journalist Jamal Khashoggi.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The administration is feeling the heat from mounting pressure to recalibrate the US-Saudi alliance and US policy on Yemen.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump continues to give the benefit of the doubt to Mohammed bin Salman, despite the preponderance of evidence that the Saudi Crown Prince directly ordered Khashoggi’s murder.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Congressional efforts to end US support for the criminal Saudi-led military campaign in Yemen have been bolstered both by the Khashoggi affair and the results of the midterm elections.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The “Murphy Amendment” introduced by Sen. Chris Murphy of Connecticut and H.Con.Res.138 sponsored by Rep. Ro Khanna of California would cut off US military assistance to the Saudi-led coalition.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for the “Murphy Amendment” introduced by Sen. Chris Murphy of Connecticut and H.Con.Res.138 sponsored by Rep. Ro Khanna of California.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for legislation Senators Bernie Sanders and Mike Lee are bringing forward, S.J.Res.54.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
